title: Serum N-glycopeptidomics of oral squamous cell carcinoma patients and healthy controls: N-glycopeptidomics
projectDescription: The serum N-glycopeptidomics of 41 oral squamous cell carcinoma patients and 44 healthy controls were compared in this project. This project is the second part of a two-part project, where proteomics and N-glycopeptidomics were analyzed in-parallel. The quantitation of N-glycopeptides was performed with MSE in sensitivity mode and the identification with MS2 Fast DDA.
sampleProcessingProtocol: The serum samples were first desalted and albumin depleted. Leftover proteins were alkylated and digested with sequence grade trypsin. The N-glycopeptides were isolated from the digested peptide pool with size exclusion chromatography (SEC).
dataProcessingProtocol: Quantitation raw files were processed in Progenesis XIP, were fold changes between the groups were calculated. Statistics were done with in-house script. Statistically significant glycopeptides were fragmented and identified in Glycopeptide ID.
